## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* miscellaneous-writings collection by **Zhúān Kěguān** 竹菴可觀. The title — *cǎolù* 艸錄 ("grass-records," i.e., draft-writings) — indicates an informal collection of notes, essays, and miscellaneous writings, complementary to Kěguān's more systematic *Shānjiā yìyuàn* ([KR6d0232](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0232)).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Kěguān's productive period c. 1140–1220.
